original_issue: Page metadata, canonical URLs and query variants
root_cause: Metadata was incomplete in the original site.
solution: Retained production-aware per-page title/description, canonical and OG/Twitter metadata; shared the origin validator with the release checker.
verification: SEO unit tests; privacy route/browser checks.
remaining_limitations: Public tags remain intentionally absent/noindex for localhost; see R02.

original_issue: Real public HTTPS origin and live indexing
root_cause: No final public domain has been supplied.
solution: Added check:release/build:release and an owner launch checklist. Never guessed a domain or enabled local indexing.
verification: check:release correctly fails only the public HTTPS-origin check; configured database/inquiry keys pass presence checks.
remaining_limitations: Owner must supply the preferred HTTPS origin, configure the deployment and rebuild. No automatic deployment performed.

original_issue: HTTPS/preferred-host redirects and HSTS
root_cause: Host ownership and deployment topology are unknown.
solution: Added opt-in www/apex canonical redirect and production HTTPS-origin-gated HSTS; local development remains HTTP.
verification: Production build and config type checks; current environment deliberately leaves the redirect off.
remaining_limitations: Live HTTPS, certificate and redirect-chain verification require the actual domain/hosting. ENFORCE_CANONICAL_HOST is off by default.

original_issue: Robots, sitemap and private route indexing/cache rules
root_cause: Original coverage omitted privacy/private paths.
solution: Retained public-only sitemap and private noindex/no-store headers; cached only public pages.
verification: Browser private-route tests; runtime private APIs 401; public response cache HIT.
remaining_limitations: Sitemap needs R02 to contain real public URLs.

original_issue: Structured local-business address/schema support
root_cause: Only a free-form address existed, insufficient for a reliable PostalAddress.
solution: Added optional owner-editable street/locality/region/postal/country fields and valid PostalAddress JSON-LD. Organization remains the fallback for incomplete facts.
verification: Complete/partial address unit tests, settings tests, strict types/build.
remaining_limitations: Real Google validation and business eligibility still require R02/R06; no result eligibility or rankings claimed.

original_issue: Missing verified business contact/address/hours
root_cause: The requested verified facts have not been provided.
solution: Added fields and clear owner readiness actions; rendered supplied address/email consistently. Asked for the missing facts.
verification: Fixture completeness checks; no invented contact/address values inserted.
remaining_limitations: Owner must provide and approve real public data. Nothing was written to the live database.

original_issue: Privacy draft, retention and contact disclosures
root_cause: A generic draft lacked editable approved wording and review information.
solution: Wired privacy contact, retention wording and owner-reviewed date through Settings; the SSR notice uses them and remains explicitly a draft until complete. Added truthful configured-provider and metric data disclosures.
verification: Privacy route test; blank settings and readiness regression tests.
remaining_limitations: Owner must approve actual policy, retention practice and contact details; no legal approval or automatic deletion is asserted.

original_issue: JSON-LD escaping and fabricated rich-result claims
root_cause: Stored strings could otherwise close an inline script; unverified details must not become schema facts.
solution: Retained escaping tests, omitted invented ratings/hours/offers, and gated Florist on complete actual address components.
verification: Script-closing round-trip test and missing-address tests pass.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: One H1, conditional heading hierarchy, semantic landmarks
root_cause: Populated testimonials/gallery and Studio footer previously had hierarchy/landmark gaps.
solution: Retained corrected H2s, semantic footer, main landmarks and named navigation.
verification: Public H1/anchor tests; axe at all requested widths and previous populated-content fixtures.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Public/private internal links and obsolete mobile test assumptions
root_cause: Tests assumed missing credentials and old hamburger-only navigation.
solution: Current dock/Menu, anchor, privacy/404 and protected route tests use real route behavior and mocked writes.
verification: 48 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit browser checks including narrow and wide layouts.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Unsafe external URLs
root_cause: Generic URL parsing previously allowed unsuitable protocols.
solution: Retained HTTPS-only approved external settings and restricted image hosts; empty optional settings still save.
verification: URL-scheme, blank setting, form-save tests; zero browser CSP violations.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Public and Studio contrast/readability
root_cause: Secondary text tokens were too light or too dark for their surfaces.
solution: Retained the palette-preserving contrast corrections; new readiness/privacy content uses those tokens.
verification: Axe responsive/public dialog checks; screenshots.
remaining_limitations: Automated checks do not certify all real screen-reader/device behavior.

original_issue: Mobile/tablet/desktop reflow and touch navigation
root_cause: Small dialogs/titles and dock ordering previously needed correction.
solution: Retained responsive layouts and validated the additional settings/notice content.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Modal keyboard access and trigger-focus restoration
root_cause: WebKit touch activation does not natively focus buttons.
solution: Explicitly focus menu trigger buttons before opening; retain Escape, background scroll locking and return focus.
verification: Initially 47/48 engine checks passed; after the fix all 48 passed, including WebKit mobile focus return.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Public form validation, duplicate requests and response states
root_cause: Generic errors and asynchronous disabled-state updates were insufficient.
solution: Retained field identification, synchronous duplicate guard, idempotency, unchecked optional consent, success reset and retry states.
verification: Mocked errors/retry/success and duplicate-submit checks on all three engines; no live inquiry sent.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Studio corrective field feedback and numeric validation
root_cause: Studio API errors did not identify the failing field.
solution: Added safe Zod field messages and focus/aria-invalid linkage; retained numeric/phone limits and valid signed/decimal business quantities.
verification: Unit/component/input validation suites, settings-save tests, strict types/build.
remaining_limitations: Database/provider-state errors remain deliberately generic to avoid leaking internal details.

original_issue: No-JavaScript usability
root_cause: Content was readable but the online form did not explain its JavaScript requirement.
solution: Added a no-JavaScript message and hid the JS-only submit action; preserved readable SSR content and links.
verification: No-JavaScript browser checks pass across engines.
remaining_limitations: Online submission still requires JavaScript; no insecure URL/query-based submission fallback added.

original_issue: Alert request cleanup and React lint failure
root_cause: Initial alerts fetch needed cancellation.
solution: Retained cancellable fetch and used the same pattern for readiness; avoided setState after cancelled animation imports.
verification: Lint clean; animation early-skip/cleanup/watchdog tests; no page errors.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: Critical development dependency advisories
root_cause: Old Vitest/worker and URI-parser versions were affected.
solution: Retained patched versions and rescanned after dependency cleanup.
verification: Final npm audit reports zero advisories across production and development dependencies.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: ESLint plugin declared peer support
root_cause: Latest upstream React/import/a11y plugins still declare ESLint <=9; ESLint 9 is out of support.
solution: Kept the supported existing ESLint 10 and tested its behavior. Did not force plugin overrides or downgrade to unsupported tooling.
verification: Registry peer ranges checked again; lint and types pass.
remaining_limitations: Upstream compatible declarations/releases are required to remove installation peer warnings safely.

original_issue: Slow public document/uncacheable cookie-bound content reads
root_cause: Public content used a request-cookie Supabase client and force-dynamic homepage rendering.
solution: Use a stateless anonymous client with tagged public fetch caching and one-minute ISR. Private/admin data is never cached.
verification: Build lists / and /privacy as static/ISR; runtime STALE then HIT with public s-maxage=60; public-cache isolation tests pass.
remaining_limitations: None for the verified local scope.

original_issue: CMS freshness after caching
root_cause: Shared caching requires invalidation after publication/settings changes.
solution: Expire public data tags and public page paths after successful authorized public-content writes/publish/delete; drafts preview bypasses caches.
verification: Three mocked publish-route tests plus cache tests prove successful save ordering, no invalidation on failure and fresh preview reads.
remaining_limitations: Live owner publish-to-host acceptance remains part of R35; no live CMS record was changed.

original_issue: Initial JavaScript and unused imports/dependencies
root_cause: Animation plugins loaded before they were needed; two old UI font packages were unused.
solution: Split website motion, lazy-load GSAP only when the intro plays, remove unused font packages/imports, preserve fonts/animation assets.
verification: Unit cleanup/race tests, full intro playback on three engines, lint/types/build.
remaining_limitations: Required React/GSAP runtime code is not treated as removable dead code.

original_issue: Forced layout/reflow and animation lifecycle
root_cause: Reveal setup interleaved geometry reads and transform writes.
solution: Batch initial reveal measurements before GSAP writes; preserve context/listener/tween cleanup and cancellation after lazy loading.
verification: Browser navigation/intro checks, no errors, cancellation/watchdog tests.
remaining_limitations: GSAP/ScrollTrigger still performs necessary geometry work; no claim of zero layout work or deletion of the approved SVG morph.

original_issue: Logo, favicon and responsive image delivery
root_cause: Oversized browser-tab variants and full-resolution display logos consumed extra bytes.
solution: Preserved exact favicon PNGs at 16/32/48px and high-resolution source; serve quality-100 responsive logos; keep original intro artwork.
verification: Favicon 67,749 to 5,898 bytes; image decode and viewport checks; original high-resolution monogram and approved logo remain.
remaining_limitations: Automatic review rejected removing a hidden intro SVG because of animation risk. It was retained; only safer asset optimizations were applied.

original_issue: Hero priority, fonts and CLS
root_cause: Hero discovery and font delivery competed with noncritical resources.
solution: Retained exact preloaded local fonts/fallbacks; add prioritized responsive hero preload and keep below-fold photos lazy.
verification: Lighthouse and browser image decode checks; responsive visual checks.
remaining_limitations: See R27 for the measured mobile loading target rather than equating an optimization with a guaranteed score.

original_issue: Mobile LCP <=2.5s
root_cause: Transfer, discovery, initial client work and document fetching affected mobile loading.
solution: Implemented R21-R26 and measured repeated production runs; preserve all approved animations.
verification: Three final production Lighthouse mobile runs: performance 86 each, median LCP 4215.18ms (range 4214.64–4284.75), CLS 0 and median TBT 15.5ms. Desktop performance 99, LCP 847.98ms.
remaining_limitations: Mobile LCP remains above the requested 2500ms target. No deployed field Core Web Vitals claim; retain approved animation and verify on real hosting/networks after R02.

original_issue: INP measurement and runtime performance visibility
root_cause: No real field traffic or privacy-approved collection was available.
solution: Added disabled-by-default minimal first-party LCP/INP/CLS collection with strict payload/origin/size checks and DNT respect.
verification: Metric privacy/size/disabled tests; runtime endpoint 404 while disabled; synthetic maximum interaction duration 64ms.
remaining_limitations: 64ms is an observed lab Event Timing duration, not field INP. Owner approval, deployed traffic and aggregation are required; collection remains off.

original_issue: CSP and security-header hardening
root_cause: There was no compatible app-wide policy or domain-gated HSTS.
solution: Added enforced self-hosted resource, object/base/frame/form restrictions and secure host policy without breaking Next/GSAP.
verification: No securitypolicyviolation events in checked flows; all browser engine tests pass.
remaining_limitations: Inline script/style allowance remains for current Next/GSAP/ISR architecture. A nonce/hash stricter policy needs a separate deployment tradeoff review.

original_issue: Owner launch checklist and release guard
root_cause: Launch blockers existed only in documentation.
solution: Added owner-protected readiness API/panel, production configuration command, and build:release gate.
verification: Owner gate tests; no secret data in response; real release check refuses the missing domain.
remaining_limitations: A configuration pass is not a substitute for the remaining manual acceptance gates.

original_issue: Cross-browser coverage
root_cause: Only Chromium had been exercised previously.
solution: Installed isolated Firefox/WebKit test engines and added repeatable opt-in projects.
verification: 48/48 checks passed on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit in wide/narrow profiles.
remaining_limitations: WebKit emulation is not a claim of physical iPhone/Safari app acceptance.

original_issue: Screen reader, text zoom and physical-device acceptance
root_cause: Automated scans do not establish full WCAG certification.
solution: Verified semantic landmarks, labels, keyboard flow, 320px reflow, focus return, reduced motion and browser engines.
verification: Axe and keyboard/reflow evidence retained.
remaining_limitations: Physical iOS/Android, VoiceOver/NVDA and user text-zoom acceptance still require manual assistive-device sessions.

original_issue: Real credentials reported missing in 19 October report
root_cause: That is a historical statement, not the present environment.
solution: Current presence checks confirm local Supabase and inquiry keys exist; historical wording is preserved with a superseding status note.
verification: check:release verifies presence without printing values.
remaining_limitations: Presence does not certify live services, delivery, staging or deployment; see R35/R36.

original_issue: FAQ/Product/review rich-result promises and 3D replacement
root_cause: No verified offers/ratings justify Product/Review schema; the approved current animation supersedes the old optional bloom-video request.
solution: Kept honest informational schema and the approved intro; did not invent rich-result facts or replace the design.
verification: Schema tests and full intro browser checks.
remaining_limitations: No ranking guarantee or automatic asset-generation/replacement is part of this remediation.

original_issue: Actual role sessions, Auth recovery and Supabase API/Storage RLS acceptance
root_cause: Isolated tests do not provide real owner/editor/accountant sessions or a separate staging environment.
solution: Retained permission guards, unit/database tests and public denial checks; no authentication bypass or production mutations used.
verification: Database tests and public denial checks pass; actual session acceptance not claimed.
remaining_limitations: Requires owner-operated staging accounts and approved live-service test fixtures.

original_issue: Payment/refund/webhook/email/SMS delivery and reconciliation acceptance
root_cause: Provider delivery/test events require approved accounts, fixtures and a reachable deployment.
solution: Preserved integrations and tested ledger/signature/alert behavior without real transactions or messages.
verification: Local automated tests pass; no live payment/email/SMS/WhatsApp sent.
remaining_limitations: External acceptance is needed. WhatsApp stays paused; no message dispatch or live payment is authorized as a test here.

original_issue: Backups, restoration, hosting, incident/MFA/session policy and monitoring transport
root_cause: These require infrastructure administration and real recovery/session decisions.
solution: Provided release controls, secure defaults and a clear acceptance procedure without changing accounts or deploying.
verification: Local configuration and guard checks pass.
remaining_limitations: Owner must verify backup restore, MFA/session limits, hosting access, monitoring transport and incident contacts.

original_issue: GST/tax invoice layout, QR and accountant approval
root_cause: Jurisdiction/accounting choices and approved document requirements were not supplied.
solution: Preserved integer-paise billing, immutable ledgers and existing PDF tests; no speculative financial model changes.
verification: Financial/PDF regression tests remain passing.
remaining_limitations: Requires accountant-approved GST breakdown, numbering, QR requirements and acceptance before implementation can be finalized.

original_issue: Suppliers, purchase orders and full event material reservations
root_cause: This is unimplemented legacy master-brief feature scope, not a known technical defect in current inventory movement logic.
solution: Cross-checked current expense/stock/task flows and preserved them; did not invent procurement/reservation contracts.
verification: Existing booking and stock-ledger tests pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires agreed supplier/PO/reservation workflow and an approved additive schema/migration plan.

original_issue: Item-price edit/removal, client tags/birthdays and expanded reporting/export
root_cause: Historical feature backlog has no supplied data-retention/editing/export acceptance rules.
solution: Current item add/effective-price and truthful current-page export remain intact.
verification: Existing UI/financial tests pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires approved product scope and safe historical billing/PII export rules; not falsely marked implemented.

original_issue: Assignment-scoped field-staff, in-app MFA/owner role editing and auxiliary schema parity
root_cause: Assignments, ownership safeguards and provider MFA policy need explicit design; reserved staff is intentionally denied broad access.
solution: Preserved role/RLS boundaries and accountant billing identity; did not enable the reserved staff role or weaken access.
verification: Role/database tests pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires approved authorization model, recovery policy and associated schema/provider setup.

original_issue: Video/multiple media, drag sorting and comprehensive reuse/deletion safeguards
root_cause: These are separate legacy media features with no approved media lifecycle or storage policy.
solution: Preserved validated public images/private attachment foundations and existing upload restrictions.
verification: Existing media tests pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires media/storage/retention decisions and safe migrations; no live media deleted or unsupported video pipeline asserted.

original_issue: Quotation communication templates, bounce callbacks and orphan provider-link UI
root_cause: Approved templates/sender/provider events and operational reconciliation rules are missing.
solution: Retained existing reviewed invoice communication and provider idempotency paths; no automatic sending introduced.
verification: Existing provider/signature/local alert tests remain passing.
remaining_limitations: Requires provider test setup, reviewed content, bounce/event contracts and owner reconciliation acceptance.

original_issue: Full multilingual CMS, section ordering and section-specific content models
root_cause: These are unimplemented legacy product features beyond the approved current structured section model.
solution: Preserved existing CMS fields, mobile order and animations; no guessed translation or content/schema redesign.
verification: Current CMS publishing/private preview tests and public navigation checks pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires approved locale/content/editorial model and additive schema/UI acceptance.

original_issue: Concurrency/load, restore and production monitoring tests
root_cause: There is no isolated staging deployment or approved load/restore target.
solution: Retained transactional/idempotency tests and added repeatable browser/configuration checks; no load was directed at live business services.
verification: Local tests/production build pass.
remaining_limitations: Requires a staging target, workload limits, restore access and monitoring alert destination.

original_issue: Private secrets in client assets
root_cause: Audit requires a boundary check, not exposing credentials in reports.
solution: Retained server-only credential access and verify compiled public assets do not contain configured secret values.
verification: Server/client boundary tests and a value-redacted compiled-asset scan.
remaining_limitations: This is not a penetration-test certification.
